note: Gates of the sighted descent version 1, frozen with it before any gate run (haltere.liftoff.sighted_descent_gates). Baseline: the round-5 Straw stack of the live plan (c) (haltere.train.deployed_pilot.deployed_pilot_kwargs(contract, stale_evidence=True): wall pilot v6, vertical guard v4, descent view v3 with contact support v3, lag turn v2, gap pilot v5, stale evidence v2; no motor assist) with the rule off; the rule adds --sighted-descent on. Held out: the surrogate course seeds and sim seed 97 below, the Straw variation seeds 1001-1032, the fresh randomisation of the logged Straw geometry (sim seed 97) and every replayed log except the two development logs. Development: SD_Straw_Development. Nothing here is flight evidence.

m5.identity: a git archive of this commit, replayed with its own haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py

pd.note: the fast PD; the checkpoint supplies only its calibration and camera

brain11cw13.note: fast-brain-11-b-cw13, the brain of the round-5 live flights

surrogate.held_out: no run in this repository or the session scratchpad used these course seeds or sim seed 97 before the freeze

straw.held_out: the development runs used sim seed 73 and variation seeds 1-24; the logged geometry itself comes from the two development logs

replays.harness: haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py of the tree named by each variant, run from that tree

SD_Identity.threshold: bit-identical command arrays (cvx, cvy, cvz, yaw_cmd, state, cap, climb, descent_scale) for m5_none = none, m5_stack = stack_off and stack_off = stack_shadow on every flight

SD_Replay_Causal.evidence: open-loop replays, held out except the two development logs
SD_Replay_Causal.threshold: on every flight the first tick whose request differs between stack_on and stack_off is a tick where the rule withheld sink

SD_Replay_KeepSpeed.threshold: on every tick where the rule withheld sink, the horizontal request with the rule is not lower than without it by more than max_lower_mps

SD_Straw_Development.evidence: development: open-loop replays of the two development logs
SD_Straw_Development.threshold: for every audited downhill contact (not the terminal impact), in the lookback_s before its start the steepest requested path with the rule is at least min_shallower_deg shallower than without it and at most max_above_los_deg steeper than ring_los_deg (the steepest line of sight to the ring over that downhill, from the offline triangulation of the in-view rays)

SD_Straw_Family.evidence: held out: Straw-like variations, seeds 1001-1032, sim seed 97
SD_Straw_Family.threshold: per controller, rule on against off: terrain contacts not more, passes more than 1.5 m above a checkpoint not more, finishes not fewer, crashes not more, paired mean finish time at most +1%; for benefit_controllers also contact seconds at most max_contact_s_ratio of off

SD_Straw_Logged.evidence: held out randomisation of the development geometry: 32 drones, sim seed 97

SD_Surrogate_Hills.evidence: held out: hill 8500-8515 and steep 8600-8607, sim seed 97
SD_Surrogate_Hills.threshold: per controller: terrain contacts not more, high passes not more, finishes not fewer, crashes not more, paired mean finish time at most +1%

SD_Flat.threshold: per controller: the same finishes and crashes, high passes not more, paired mean finish time within +-1%
